topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: Discovering that my online friend inhabits the very same city as I do was no trivial revelation. We've shared countless hours, delving into the deepest corners of our minds, all the while continents apart—or so we thought. The digital realm, with its borderline mystical ability to bridge gaps, yet again reveals its true prowess. To think, all this time, there was a tangible layer to our connection, a reality grounded in the same streets and paths. The world does indeed feel smaller, more intimate, with this new layer of understanding. Our next steps are clear, and I'll be damned if I let the novelty of this discovery slip into the mundane.
